details.title: Join your team
details.lead: Type your phone number and the join code from your invite message.

selfie.title: Take a photo when you check in
selfie.body: {{org}} asks for a selfie with every check-in, so {{owner}} knows it's really you. Photos are deleted after 30 days.
selfie.withdraw: You can take this back later under Me, My data. Your check-ins then go to {{owner}} to approve.
selfie.required: Selfies are on for this salon, so this is needed to continue. Talk to {{owner}} if you have questions.

pin.title: Set your PIN
pin.lead: You'll use it to sign in and to check in. Keep it to yourself.
pin.label: New PIN
pin.tooWeak: Pick a PIN that's harder to guess. Avoid repeats like 1111, runs like 1234 and the end of your phone number.

confirm.title: Type your PIN again
confirm.label: Your PIN again
confirm.mismatch: Those PINs don't match. Set your PIN again.

notifications.title: Get alerts
notifications.lead: Get a ping when {{owner}} approves your phone, your leave, or your payslip.

unsupported.title: This phone can't keep the app's key

notice.heading: How the app uses your information
notice.location: We check your location only when you tap Check in or Check out, to confirm you are at the salon.
notice.keep: We keep exact locations for 90 days and selfies for 30 days.

full.collectBody: Your name, phone number and joining date; this phone's security key; your check-in and check-out times; your location at those moments; and a selfie, only if the salon asks for one.
full.whyBody: To record your attendance and work out your pay. Never for marketing, and never to score you.
full.keepBody: Exact locations for 90 days and selfies for 30 days. Wage records for 5 years, as the law requires. When you leave, your selfies and locations are deleted within 30 days.
full.whoBody: {{owner}}, and a manager if she adds one. Nobody else.
full.rightsBody: See your data any time under Me, My data. Ask {{owner}} to correct a day, and take back selfie consent whenever you like.

waiting.title: Waiting for approval
waiting.body: {{Owner}} needs to approve this phone before you can check in. We've let her know.
waiting.replacing: This will replace your other phone once {{owner}} approves.
waiting.signInLater: Once {{owner}} approves this phone, sign in with your phone number and PIN.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.lead: Sign in with your phone number and PIN.
signIn.forgotAnswer: Ask {{owner}} to reset your PIN. She'll send you a new invite, and your phone stays set up.

start.title: Join your team
start.lead: Set up the app on this phone with the join code from your invite message.

new.title: Set up your new phone
new.lead: Type your phone number and PIN. {{Owner}} will get a request to approve this phone.

owner.title: Owner sign-in
owner.lead: We'll email you a sign-in link and a 6-digit code.
owner.sent: If this email belongs to an owner, a link is on its way.
owner.resent: We sent a new email. It can take a minute.
owner.codeLead: Type the 6-digit code here, or tap the link in the email.
owner.passwordLead: Use the password and owner PIN you set in Settings, Security.

stepUp.title: Enter your owner PIN
stepUp.lead: This keeps pay, staff and devices safe. You won't be asked again for 10 minutes.
stepUp.noPin: Set an owner PIN first, in Settings, Security.
